definitions.primary: Mean completion latency from fixed external arrival, all requests.
definitions.cohorts: Grouped by predeclared external arrival_s, not observed admission.
definitions.dispatch_start_lag: Timestamp immediately before add_request minus external arrival; enqueue call completion is not instrumented.
definitions.drain: Report service duration from origin, duration after final external arrival, and post-completion connector drain separately.
definitions.quality: Equal fixed output counts do not establish equal native compute, token content, or task quality.
definitions.uncertainty: One arm is one run; request differences are descriptive and do not supply independent run-level samples.

capacity_pressure.interpretation: Observed GPU occupancy at schedule/step/preempt boundaries; Host residency and running/waiting at step boundaries. This is neither a cap-based demand upper bound nor a complete GPU allocator high-water mark.

output_work_comparison.interpretation: Same observed output counts per request; this alone does not establish quality or equal internal compute.

token_consistency.interpretation: Greedy output-sequence consistency diagnostic only; neither equality nor difference establishes task quality.

request_differences.direction: right minus left; descriptive paired requests, not independent run repetitions
